events.what: Zhang claims both directions of Fuglede's conjecture fail in R^2 via 60-point sets in Z60xZ12 transferred to unions of unit squares
events.credibility_reason: An automated Pith Review flags a notational error in the transference argument for the non-tiling direction; unpatched (only v1), no expert uptake yet. Automated review is not a knock-down (F11).

events.what: Shi proves Fuglede's conjecture (spectral implies tile) for unions of three intervals in R

judgement.doubts: The bullet asks about both R and R^2; Zhang addresses only R^2, so even if correct it is a case, not whole (F1/F2). Both events are partial; Zhang chosen as the more substantial case. Direction across the two cases goes both ways (Shi confirms a restricted R case), so 'mixed' is defensible; kept 'refuted' as the direction of the chosen event. Zhang's non-tiling direction depends on fixing a flagged transference error; the tile-without-spectrum direction may stand alone.

corrections.why: F1/F2: the bullet covers nonconvex sets in both R and R^2; Zhang's preprint (arXiv:2607.15632) claims only dimension two, so it settles a case, and Shi's three-interval result is also a case. An unreviewed case is partial, not claimed.

other: kept as the direction of Zhang's event, but the two settled cases point opposite ways (Shi confirms three-interval sets in R), so 'mixed' is arguable; Zhang's non-tiling direction also rests on an argument flagged by Pith Review.
